about: The third-party programs inside the enclave image, all prebuilt by AWS and taken unmodified from the blobs of aws-nitro-enclaves-cli (nix/aws-blobs.nix). For each: where it is in the image, the SHA-256 of its binary, its license, where its source is, and how sure that is: exact (shown to be the source of this binary), aws-stated (the source AWS says it built this binary from, not shown), unavailable (AWS does not publish the source of this binary). scripts/image-inventory.ts checks an image against this file; CI runs it on every image it builds. Permaily does not distribute the image (docs/decisions/0023).

components.name: Linux kernel 4.14.256-209.484.amzn2.aarch64
components.where: Not published. Its configuration is blobs/aarch64/Image.config of aws-nitro-enclaves-cli v1.5.2, byte for byte configs/microvm-kernel-config-aarch64 of https://github.com/aws/aws-nitro-enclaves-sdk-bootstrap at ed24913346a34d719afa2031299253160a2e3460.
components.note: The binary reports 'Linux version 4.14.256-209.484.amzn2.aarch64 (mockbuild@ip-10-0-42-103) (gcc version 7.3.1 20180712 (Red Hat 7.3.1-13) (GCC)) #1 SMP Tue Jan 11 21:47:26 UTC 2022', an Amazon Linux 2 kernel built by Amazon's build system. The Amazon Linux 2 source repository has kernel-4.14.256-197.484.amzn2.src.rpm and no 209.484, and aws-nitro-enclaves-sdk-bootstrap builds linux-4.14.204, so the source of this build is not published (read 2026-11-12).

components.name: nsm.ko, Nitro Secure Module driver
components.where: nsm-driver/nsm.c of https://github.com/aws/aws-nitro-enclaves-sdk-bootstrap at ed24913346a34d719afa2031299253160a2e3460 (unchanged since 9a1a825), built against the kernel above.
components.note: The module's srcversion (D3B5E8FDCD94DD8FF56025B) is the MD4 digest the kernel's modpost takes of the module's source, and that nsm.c gives the same value.

components.name: init
components.note: AWS replaced the blob on 2024-05-22, 25 minutes after merging that commit, and cited it. It was built with GCC 11.4.1 20230605 (Red Hat 11.4.1-2) and is not reproducible from that source, so the correspondence rests on AWS's word.

components.name: GNU C Library, statically linked into init
components.note: init is linked with -static. The binary does not record which release of the library it contains, and AWS does not say.
